allowed_variations: Choose a fixed larger register count or a specified nonabelian operation family.

actual_scope: Exact four-register census of binary off-diagonal patterns of rational rank-one idempotents, plus a bounded exact screen of the fixed 15-address/two-relation candidate family for four rank-four targets.
scope_change_reason: The open task was refined to the smallest next case beyond research/bit-one-relation-seed04: four registers and exactly two independent rational address relations. The result is a finite structural census and a scoped candidate obstruction; it does not establish a general lower bound or a construction.
bottleneck_link: A local bit-call saving could improve the bit supplier, but the selected conditional kappa is currently limited by the complex saving. This census and bounded obstruction do not change the supplier endpoint or selected kappa; they narrow the structural search needed for a future construction.
stop_rule: Complete the exact census with two implementations, verify the fixed 16-call baseline and negative controls, and test all 20 exceptional pattern planes under all six relation-signature assignments for the predetermined first-seven-prefix ansatz. Stop there; do not infer a universal two-relation impossibility or search other address lists.
evidence: verify.py and CERTIFICATE.json: 120 rank-one idempotents, 105 off-diagonal patterns, 196 realizable two-planes, of which 176 have common topological order and 20 have cyclic union; exact first-seven-prefix screen covers 120 plane/signature assignments and finds zero diagonal singleton endpoints. The exact 16-call baseline passes; dropping a call and corrupting an address are rejected. Certificate SHA-256: 690de78db74c1ba59a4092b8f7b9f8f54c5d53d3650d9e8d78448cdddda18321. No kappa improvement.
